g.text: New Workspace offers, and the one it opens on. Add your own .ctech - a fab's stackup, or one saved from the technology
editor - and it is offered from then on. A new workspace gets its own copy of whichever you choose, so removing one here never changes a design
RFIC Si (3 Layer Metal + TFR, 100um, example)
New workspaces open on this one. Every new workspace can still choose another, or
